Under the direction of the Research Administrator, the incumbent independently coordinates the research efforts of research projects at the Susan Samueli Integrative Health Institute (SSIHI). The position oversees multiple research projects and is responsible for IRB development, submission and maintenance. The position functions as resource to advise principal investigators and other research staff, develops Standard Operating Procedures for research activities, leads and participates in staff meetings to communicate progress, and provides project management support to the principal investigator. Additionally, the position ensures implementation of desired changes to the protocol or study design based upon decisions by the Principal Investigator and provides database management and inventory and creates summary reports as needed.
Highly attentive to proper handling of confidential information and documents.
May require study management coordination outside of normal business hours.

May require travel to satellite sites.
Access to transportation to off-site research locations.
Ability to analyze a problem from inception to completion and provide suggested solutions.

Effective and professional interpersonal skills.
Ability to function well in a team environment.
Ability to maintain accurate records and database files.
Organizational skills to prioritize workload.
Ability to operate a networked PC in a Windows environment with proficiency in MS Word and Excel, with data entry skills.
